requirements.general: Any of These: SPM/O-Levels: Minimum 5 credits (C's), including Mathematics, English, Physics, Chemistry, and Additional Mathematics. IB MYP: 3 subjects with Grade 6 (English, Mathematics, and Physics/Chemistry). 2 subjects with Grade 5 (Additional Mathematics and Physics/Chemistry). Conditional Offers: Available for students with forecast results. Advance Standing: May be granted for those with appropriate pre-university qualifications. Final results are required before the program starts. Pre-requisite Subjects: Progression to an undergraduate program may require specific grades in pre-requisite subjects at SPM/O-Level/Equivalent levels, in addition to Foundation results. English Language Requirements: For Non-Native English Speakers: Evidence of English language ability is required. Minimum IELTS 5.5 (or equivalent) with no score below 5.0. English Language Courses: Offered for those who do not meet the IELTS 5.5 requirement.
